_note: retail_waste_pct: FAO (2011) Annex 4, North America & Oceania, 'Distribution: Supermarket Retail' column (estimated/assumed % of what enters the stage). co2e: Poore & Nemecek (2018) global mean, kg CO2e per kg product, via Our World in Data (data year 2010). Used for the Store A calibration check and the CO2e KPI.

sources.fao2011: Gustavsson, J. et al. (2011). Global Food Losses and Food Waste — Extent, Causes and Prevention. FAO, Rome. Annex 4, table for North America and Oceania. https://www.fao.org/4/mb060e/mb060e.pdf
sources.poore2018: Poore, J. & Nemecek, T. (2018). Reducing food's environmental impacts through producers and consumers. Science 360(6392). Values via Our World in Data, 'Greenhouse gas emissions per kilogram of food product'. https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/ghg-per-kg-poore
